description: Camoufox web search tool profile for codefreedom — configures container image, ports, and data directory.
notes: The 'camoufox' block defines all settings for 'codefreedom tools web'.
'image' is the Docker image to use — change to 'ghcr.io/nilayparikh/codefreedom:camoufox-latest' for published builds.
'container_name' is the Docker container name (persistent, restart unless-stopped).
'port' is the host port that maps to container port 8420 (MCP server).
'data_dir' is the host path mounted to /userdata inside the container.
'env' are environment variables forwarded to the container.
